name: Warden
statusNote: Private and self-hosted. The workspace shell carries the upstream project's full test suite; the desk integration is additive and read-only — no order surface exists anywhere in it.
oneLiner: A self-hosted AI workspace with the whole Sentinel desk living inside it — chat, notes, and research in the same place as the market panels, and none of it able to trade.
stack: FastAPI (Python) + vanilla JS, forked from an open-source workspace
The Sentinel suite's real engines, imported — never re-implemented
Local LLM via Ollama — no cloud model, no API keys

components.name: workspace shell
components.desc: The forked self-hosted AI workspace: chat, agents, notes, documents, research — Warden's changes ride additively on top so upstream merges stay clean.

components.name: engine bridge
components.desc: A thin adapter that imports the Sentinel suite's real Python engines and returns JSON to the panels; the golden-vector math stays single-source in the suite.

components.name: desk routes
components.desc: Read-only API surface: list sessions, render reports, run analyses, proxy Q&A to the local model. No trading endpoints exist.

components.name: desk panels
components.desc: Native UI for the market section: session scoreboard, order-flow evidence, iceberg/absorption verdicts, 0DTE skew reads, and a cross-session backtest grid.

components.name: analyst
components.desc: The suite's institutional-desk analyst prompt reused verbatim; the workspace's local model writes the end-of-day read and caches it beside the session.

components.name: council
components.desc: A four-persona second read (risk, momentum, contrarian, tape) over the same session data — same local model, deliberately different lenses.

components.name: host agent
components.desc: A small launcher on the host for one-click pipeline runs; the capture side stays outside the container, the workspace only ever reads the artifacts.

dataFlow: The Sentinel suite watches live market data through TWS on the host and records every session to tapes and a session report.
Those artifacts are mounted into the workspace read-only — the desk can see them, never touch them.
The desk routes load a session and the engine bridge runs the suite's real analysis engines over it.
Native panels render the scoreboard, order-flow evidence, iceberg verdicts, 0DTE skew reads, and the cross-session backtest grid.
The local model writes the analyst read in the desk voice; the council adds four dissenting second reads.
Everything renders and caches locally — the only network the desk knows is the local model endpoint.
integrations: IBKR/TWS — upstream of the suite, never touched by Warden itself
decisions: Additive fork discipline: new files plus a handful of core edits, so upstream workspace updates merge cleanly.
Import, never copy: the suite's math has one source of truth; the bridge calls it instead of re-implementing it.
Read-only forever: no order placement, modification, or routing code exists anywhere in the desk layer.
The model is local: analyst and council run on Ollama; nothing about a session leaves the machine.
Honest nulls: missing values render as n/a — the desk never invents a number.
Host/container boundary: capture and the Rust cockpit live on the host; the workspace renders and reads.
